sources.keyIo: Bitcoin Core src/test/data/key_io_valid.json and key_io_invalid.json (addresses, scripts, WIF on main / test / testnet4 / signet / regtest)
sources.bip350: BIP-350 test vectors (valid segwit addresses with their scriptPubKeys, invalid addresses)
sources.sighash: Bitcoin Core src/test/data/sighash.json: every 5th of the 500 legacy signature hash vectors [tx, script, index, hashType, hash (display order)]
sources.bip143: BIP-143 examples: the signed / unsigned transactions of the BIP (the inputs and sighashes are listed in test.js)
sources.bip341: BIP-341 bip-0341/wallet-test-vectors.json (scriptPubKey construction, key path signing)
sources.psbt: Bitcoin Core test/functional/data/rpc_psbt.json (BIP-174 / 370 / 371 / 373 valid and invalid PSBTs, creator, signer, combiner, finalizer, extractor)
sources.descriptors: BIP-380 .. BIP-387 and BIP-389 test vectors (valid descriptors with their scripts, invalid descriptors)
